testId: tests/webstore/CartCheckoutPage/CartCheckoutPageTest.spec.ts > SAN-018 SAN-025 SAN-004: Market Coordinator sees all four sections; PLP tile and PLP cart entry work

scenario.summary: An Admin uses Shop As on a created Market Coordinator with a saved address and an allotment; after Redeem Now the combined page shows Address and Contact, Questionnaire, Delivery and Order Summary and Place Order; a PLP tile opens the PDP and the PLP cart entry opens the combined page.
steps: Sign in on the storefront (config webstoreURL, /login) with the tester's own Admin account (config adminUsername / adminPassword, from env ADMIN_USERNAME / ADMIN_PASSWORD); the Web Admin Dashboard (/admin) opens
In Web Admin open Users, find the created Market Coordinator by its user name (@user.userName) and choose Shop As; the storefront opens as that user with the impersonation header
Open the PDP /product/{@product.parentProductId}; the size grid is shown
Enter quantity 1 for size @product.variant1Attr1 and click Redeem Now (SAN-018)
Check Address and Contact, Questionnaire, Delivery (heading Delivery) and Order Summary (with @product.variant1Sku) and the Place Order button (SAN-018, SAN-025)
Click Cart in the Header; check the same sections (SAN-025 step 1)
Open the PLP and click the tile of @product.name; check its PDP opens (SAN-004)
Return to the PLP and use its cart entry; check the combined page opens with the cart line (SAN-004)
stateChanges: The Market Coordinator user, its allotment and its default address are created for the test by their collections and deleted at teardown
Cart line added by Redeem Now
assertions: The Questionnaire section is shown together with Address and Contact, Delivery and Order Summary and the Place Order button for the Market Coordinator
The Order Summary lists the redeemed line
A PLP tile opens the product's PDP
The PLP cart entry opens the combined page with the cart line
evidence: Jira BMP-94 (story, FSD section 'Shopping Cart and Checkout', work/stories/BMP-94/input/) and manual cases SAN-018, SAN-025, SAN-004 (work/stories/BMP-94/input/BMP-94-testcases.md)

work/stories/BMP-94/analysis.md section 6: every role test signs in with the tester's own Admin account and reaches the created user through Shop As (user decision 2026-11-26); created users never sign in with a password, so 'signed in as <role>' in the cases is reached through Shop As

PRODUCT_CONFIGURABLE_SIZE_GRID (existing BNJM size-grid products, no price rule: BNJM variants are priced 0.00; user decision 2026-11-27) replaces the hardcoded /product/798 (BM05) and size Small of the cases; on qa product 798 (SKU BM05) is configured by attribute Size (ZnodePimConfigureProductAttribute -> PimAttributeId 129, AttributeCode Size), so variantAttributes = Size

Allotments: BIWW Allocations custom table, linked to the rep only by SalesRepEmail (analysis section 9); one ALLOTMENT_OF_USER_FOR_VARIANT need per variant the test enters, quantity = the highest quantity the test reaches for it
SAN-018 and SAN-025 name the Market Coordinator reached through Shop As in their test data; the named tester account is not used (created user, analysis section 2)

qa finding (2026-11-27): the Header Cart opens a cart drawer; its Checkout link opens the combined page. Defect against SAN-011 (user, 2026-11-27; config/known-failures.yaml): the Header Cart should open the combined page directly. T2 soft-checks the direct open (fails on qa) and then goes on through the drawer, as the other tests do
qa finding (2026-11-27): the section headings on qa are lowercase "Address and contact" and "Order summary"; the test compares the FRD texts "Address and Contact" / "Order Summary" case-insensitively
